derivation: from a compound of G3491 (ναῦς) and G71 (ἄγω);
def: to be shipwrecked (stranded, "navigate"), literally or figuratively

occurrences.text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
